# VehicleChacha - Pakistan's Trusted Car Advisor

> Find the right car for your budget in Pakistan. Compare new cars, check prices, read reviews, and get personalized recommendations.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://vehiclechacha.vercel.app) - Find cars by budget
- [New Cars](https://vehiclechacha.vercel.app/new-cars) - Browse all new cars in Pakistan
- [Car Prices](https://vehiclechacha.vercel.app/car-prices) - Latest car prices in Pakistan
- [Compare Cars](https://vehiclechacha.vercel.app/compare) - Side-by-side car comparison
- [Find My Car](https://vehiclechacha.vercel.app/find-my-car) - Personalized car recommendation wizard
- [Guides](https://vehiclechacha.vercel.app/guides) - Car buying guides for Pakistan
- [How We Score](https://vehiclechacha.vercel.app/how-we-score) - Chacha Match™ scoring methodology

## About

VehicleChacha helps Pakistani car buyers find the right new car based on budget, family size, driving habits, and preferences. We provide transparent scoring (Chacha Match™), real-time prices, user reviews, and expert guidance.
